title: NEXY autonomous round 5 — migration apply/rollback build gate
scope: DOC-C §15.1/§15.2 migration tests + rollback build-fail rule and DOC-E E3/E12 execution proof
inputs_summary: Authoritative DOC-C test-gate contract, DOC-E evidence contract, current latest Prisma migration, CI workflow and release attestation.
actions: Verified authoritative DOC-C §15.1 requires migration tests and §15.2 requires any migration rollback failure to fail the build.
Verified DOC-E E3 requires migration applied + rollback tested and E12 requires rollback playbook execution proof.
Added .nexy/migration-proof.json pinning the latest migration and exact pre-migration schema SHA.

Added scripts/migration-proof.ts to materialize base schema from Git, push it to ephemeral PostgreSQL, apply latest migration, diff to current schema, rollback, diff to base schema, re-apply, and diff to current again.
Added real PostgreSQL 16 CI migration gate and uploaded per-run migration-proof artifact.
Added static contract tests for proof manifest/script/workflow.
Observed real migration round-trip PASS on run 35552884071 before making it release-blocking.
Added migration_rollback to runtime attestation required-gate schema, bumped attestation contract from v3 to v4, and bound the gate into integrity/deployment verification.
Ran final complete CI on SHA 6bc72ebe6de6ade6c21808f0e5ffd93d4772e5ad.

claims_proofs.claim: Pre-R5 CI did not execute a real migration apply/rollback test.
claims_proofs.proof: Workflow had no PostgreSQL migration job; rollback script existence alone was not execution evidence.

claims_proofs.claim: Latest migration round-trip is proven on a real PostgreSQL service.
claims_proofs.proof: Workflow 35553033907 Migration apply / rollback gate passed; proof script performed base push → apply → current schema diff → rollback → base schema diff → re-apply → current schema diff.

claims_proofs.claim: Migration rollback is now release-blocking and attested.
claims_proofs.proof: runtime attestation v4 requires migration_rollback; release-attestation/deploy workflow dependencies include migration-proof; negative contract test blocks failed migration_rollback.

successes: Real database migration round-trip proof exists and is uploaded per CI run.
Rollback mismatch/failure now fails the migration job.
Release attestation cannot omit or ignore migration_rollback gate.
decisions: Rollback proof must compare database schema to explicit pre-migration schema SHA, not only rely on non-zero/zero SQL execution.
Migration proof artifact is per workflow run and records commit/run/operator/environment/result metadata.
Attestation schema was version-bumped because required gate set changed.
unresolved: UI truth fail-closed behavior remains incorrect when health state is unknown/unreachable.
UI critical browser E2E gate remains absent.
Coverage requirement domain/core/law/judge=90% and API routes=85% remains unresolved; 'domain' package mapping requires authoritative interpretation before enforcement.
risks: Migration proof currently targets the latest migration; future latest migration must update the manifest/base schema SHA or CI fails by design.
Deployment remains NON_DEPLOYABLE because remaining DOC-E evidence categories are not fully encoded/proven.
limits: R5 proves migration gate, not all historical migration rollback paths.
rollback: Revert R5 commits on the dedicated branch if the authoritative migration evidence contract changes; do not bypass the migration gate.
next_actions: Fix UI truth fail-open READY default/silent health failure.
Add browser-level critical-flow E2E gate after UI truth behavior is corrected.
